evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce DocAttriBench (DAB), a large-scale benchmark for fine-grained, element-level source attribution in Document VQA, grounding answers to specific layout elements such as text blocks, tables, and images.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Answer grounding in document visual question answering remains an open challenge: most benchmarks lack grounding annotations or provide limited-quality labels, while constructing grounded datasets still requires costly manual effort.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: We benchmark grounding-capable multimodal LLMs on DAB, evaluating answer accuracy, attribution accuracy, and overall answer quality.

evidence.label: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围
evidence.excerpt: Applying MAPPET to multiple existing Document VQA datasets yields DAB, with 237k documents and 296k question-answer pairs with element-level grounding.
